rules.companion: same-profile key4.db or legacy key3.db when key4 is absent
rules.locator: SQLite metadata: id/password, nssPrivate: a11/a102; legacy BDB global-salt/password-check/private-key records
rules.decoder: Firefox NSS password check and credential key unwrap

rules.locator: Decrypted item display-name and application attribute
rules.decoder: Iterated SHA256, AES-128-CBC and MD5 consistency verification
rules.automatic: Empty-password or explicitly supplied known keyring password; no guesses

rules.locator: Exact Chrome/Chromium Keys folder and Safe Storage password entry
rules.decoder: Legacy SHA1 or PBKDF2-SHA512, Blowfish ECB/CBC, SHA1 consistency verification
rules.automatic: Empty-password or explicitly supplied known wallet password; GPG stays locked

rules.decoder: SQLCipher raw key; encryptedKey uses Linux Chromium SafeStorage
rules.automatic: Plaintext key, v10 wrap, or v11 with a supported same-user SafeStorage item

rules.locator: TDF$ wrapper: big-endian length-prefixed salt and encrypted local key after byte offset 8
rules.automatic: Empty-passcode wraps supported by the decoder

rules.locator: GKeyFile [item] secret or binary-secret; display-name and item:attributeN application association
rules.decoder: Unencrypted GNOME textual keyring only; exact application association required
rules.automatic: Same-user Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Edge or Signal Safe Storage item
